places.name: Sri Aurobindo Ashram
places.description: A profound centre of integral yoga philosophy and one of India's most respected ashrams.

places.name: Auroville

places.name: French Quarter (White Town)
places.description: The best-preserved French colonial streetscape in all of Asia.

places.name: Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Jesus
places.description: One of the finest examples of Gothic ecclesiastical architecture in South India.

places.name: Pondicherry Museum
places.description: The best introduction to both the Tamil and French layers of Pondicherry's layered history.

places.name: Serenity Beach
places.description: The best place in Pondicherry to catch waves or learn to surf.

places.name: Manakula Vinayagar Temple
places.description: The most visited and spiritually charged temple in Pondicherry, right in the French Quarter.

places.name: Paradise Beach
places.description: Pondicherry's most beautiful and unspoiled beach, worth the ferry ride.

places.name: Chunnambar Backwaters
places.description: The easiest way to experience peaceful backwater scenery close to Pondicherry.
